meta.quantiles: median, p10 and p90 over the quartier's homes (2021 Census dissemination-area points), weighted by occupied dwellings, inverse CDF without interpolation
meta.null_meaning: A null time listed in over_max means more than max_trip_min (no trip found within the limit). Any other null means no data.

out_of_scope.reason: L'Île-Dorval: island municipality with no bridge and only a seasonal ferry; not reachable by public transit, so excluded from Dorval's commute statistics.

sources: Transit schedules: Société de transport de Montréal, Réseau express métropolitain and exo, CC BY 4.0. Travel times are derived from these schedules.

udem.rule_note: Per home, the campus time is the fastest of the campus buildings below (optimistic: assumes you go to whichever building is quickest for you). Each building's own time is in by_destination.
